configure.title: Chiratidzo chenhanho
configure.description: Ratidza matanho semutsara mupfupi wemisoro unoratidza fambiro. Zviri mukati menhanho hazviratidzwe mumarongerwo aya.

configure.title: Nhanho iripo
configure.description: Nhanho iyo muverengi aripo, kuverenga kubva pa1. Matanho ekare anoratidzwa seapedzwa. Inoshandiswa nechiratidzo chenhanho.
